name: Salt Cod With Egg Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: salt cod soaked, boiled and picked up very fine
ingredients.originalText: 1 lb. salt cod soaked, boiled and picked up very fine

ingredients.name: as much mashed potato as fish
ingredients.originalText: Half as much mashed potato as fish

instructions.text: Thicken with the flour, then the potato rubbed very fine
Add the butter, the eggs, and parsley
Stir and toss until smoking hot all through
Alternatively: make a sauce of all the ingredients except the fish and potato
Mix the fish and potato well together with a little melted butter
Heat in a saucepan, stirring all the while
Heap in the centre of a dish and pour the sauce over all

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Heat the milk
2. Thicken with the flour, then the potato rubbed very fine
3. Add the butter, the eggs, and parsley
4. Last, add the fish
5. Stir and toss until smoking hot all through
6. Pour into a deep dish
7. Alternatively: make a sauce of all the ingredients except the fish and potato
8. Mix the fish and potato well together with a little melted butter
9. Heat in a saucepan, stirring all the while
10. Heap in the centre of a dish and pour the sauce over all
